column1: # Low-energy electronic stopping coefficients (docs/upgrade/stopping.md section 4).  One row per element and
# projectile; the evaluation joins them to Bethe's formula (src/Electronic.cpp).
# form AZ_p (protons, T = proton energy in keV): S_low = A2 T^0.45, S_high = (A3/T) ln(1 + A4/T + A5 T),
#   S = S_low S_high / (S_low + S_high) in eV/(1e15 atoms/cm^2) for T >= 10 keV; below 10 keV S is continued
#   proportional to the velocity from its 10-keV value.  A1 (the published coefficient of A1 sqrt(T) below 10 keV)
#   is kept as published and not used.  Source: H. H. Andersen and J. F. Ziegler, "Hydrogen Stopping Powers and
#   Ranges in All Elements" (Pergamon, 1977), as revised and adopted in ICRU Report 49 (1993).
